newsitem.title: UK: GWR denies has plans to buy Westcountry tv.
newsitem.headline: GWR denies has plans to buy Westcountry tv.

text.p: Expanding UK commercial radio operator GWR Group Plc, which wants to buy Classic FM Plc, denied on Tuesday that it had any plans to buy Westcountry Television Ltd.

In a statement responding to newspaper comment about a possible purchase, GWR said its management would be concentrating in the coming months on integrating Classic FM if its acquisition went ahead and on increasing revenues and margins.
"In the face of the rapidly changing regulatory environment in the UK media sector, the board of GWR is in the process of re-evaluating the group's long-term development strategy," it stated.
But the company added: "All growth opportunities in the media sector are kept under constant scrutiny."
